passes.finding: Loadout explains slots and per-round action; current/next round and intent panel visible. Dense party footer can require vertical scrolling at 720px.
Faces, cafe materials and actual loadout/loot make the upgrade visible. Thin enemy profiles and repeated base body construction remain.
Gear properties, consumable action cost, interrupt and seeded build path change outcomes; automatic first-loot choice can still lose. No human testing.

43 distinct authored glyphs/paths with separate portraits and shaped traces. Quiet bottom-third cues received larger grounded signatures and offset emblems. Shared particle/ribbon grammar remains recognizable; cannot certify every effect as premium or non-generic.

Twelve turnarounds, 22-clip sheets and action recordings show expressive faces and softer surfaces. Binding Thread and Practice Cushion rebuilt. Distinct models remain unequal; no claim that all exceed the mean.
